name: Darvas box with three-day confirmed walls
note: The box is built exactly as Darvas described it. A new hi_n-bar high on volume above vol_mult times the 50-bar average opens a candidate ceiling; the ceiling only counts once conf consecutive bars have all failed to exceed it, and any bar that does exceed it resets the ceiling and restarts the count. Then the lowest low made since the ceiling bar becomes the candidate floor, confirmed the same way, restarting on any violation. Entry is the breakout above the confirmed ceiling plus off_atr*ATR. The exit is the box floor and nothing else -- no profit target -- and it RATCHETS: when a new box completes higher the floor rises with it, and it never falls.
source: Nicolas Darvas, 'How I Made $2,000,000 in the Stock Market' (1960); algorithmic box construction with the three-consecutive-day confirmation rule for both ceiling and floor described at https://clickalgo.com/darvas-box-theory and https://investinganswers.com/dictionary/d/darvas-box-theory

def family_init(ctx):
    from collections import deque
    bars = ctx.bars
    N = len(bars)
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    v = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]
    hn = max(20, int(ctx.p.hi_n))
    vn = max(5, int(ctx.p.vol_n))
    conf = max(1, int(ctx.p.conf))
    vm = float(ctx.p.vol_mult)
    oa = float(ctx.p.off_atr)
    an = max(2, int(ctx.p.atr_n))

    at = [None] * N
    tr = 0.0
    acc = 0.0
    for j in range(1, N):
        t = h[j] - l[j]
        t2 = abs(h[j] - c[j - 1])
        t3 = abs(l[j] - c[j - 1])
        if t2 > t:
            t = t2
        if t3 > t:
            t = t3
        if j <= an:
            acc += t
            if j == an:
                tr = acc / an
                at[j] = tr
        else:
            tr = (tr * (an - 1) + t) / an
            at[j] = tr

    dq = deque()
    rmax = [None] * N
    for j in range(N):
        while dq and h[dq[-1]] <= h[j]:
            dq.pop()
        dq.append(j)
        while dq[0] <= j - hn:
            dq.popleft()
        if j >= hn - 1:
            rmax[j] = h[dq[0]]

    vs = [None] * N
    s = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        s += v[j]
        if j >= vn:
            s -= v[j - vn]
        if j >= vn - 1:
            vs[j] = s / vn

    sig = [0] * N
    stp = [None] * N
    st = 0
    hbox = 0.0
    lcand = 0.0
    lows = 0.0
    cnt = 0
    stop = None
    for i in range(N):
        a = at[i]
        off = oa * a if a else 0.0
        if stop is not None and c[i] < stop - off:
            stop = None
        if st == 0:
            if (i >= 1 and rmax[i] is not None and vs[i - 1] is not None
                    and h[i] >= rmax[i] - 1e-12 and v[i] >= vm * vs[i - 1]):
                hbox = h[i]
                lows = l[i]
                cnt = 0
                st = 1
        elif st == 1:
            if h[i] > hbox:
                hbox = h[i]
                lows = l[i]
                cnt = 0
            else:
                if l[i] < lows:
                    lows = l[i]
                cnt += 1
                if cnt >= conf:
                    lcand = lows
                    cnt = 0
                    st = 2
        elif st == 2:
            if h[i] > hbox:
                hbox = h[i]
                lows = l[i]
                cnt = 0
                st = 1
            elif l[i] < lcand:
                lcand = l[i]
                cnt = 0
            else:
                cnt += 1
                if cnt >= conf:
                    if stop is None or lcand > stop:
                        stop = lcand
                    st = 3
        else:
            if h[i] > hbox + off:
                sig[i] = 1
                hbox = h[i]
                lows = l[i]
                cnt = 0
                st = 1
            elif l[i] < lcand:
                st = 0
        stp[i] = stop
    ctx.sg = ctx.series(sig, "darvas_break")
    ctx.stp = ctx.series(stp, "box_floor")


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sg[i]
    return 1 if s else 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    s = ctx.stp[i]
    if s is None:
        return True
    return ctx.c[i] < s
